# opencode-free-model-watch An OpenCode TUI plugin. At each start, it compares the model list to the previous start. It then shows a notice for each model that became free, and for each new free model. A model counts as free only when all of its cost entries are zero. ## Install ```sh opencode plugin github:NikiHrs/opencode-free-model-watch ``` Add `-g` to install in the global config. Restart OpenCode after the install. Requirements: - An OpenCode version with TUI plugin support (plugin API `@opencode/plugin` 2.x) - Bun, which OpenCode uses to load TUI plugins ## How it works - On the first start, the plugin records a baseline and shows how many free models it tracks. - On the first start of each later day, it compares the current model list to the most recent start and shows a report when models became free. - State is stored with OpenCode plugin storage on your machine. The plugin sends no data anywhere. To silence the plugin, remove its entry from the `plugins` list in your OpenCode config. To re-baseline, clear the `free-models` entry from OpenCode plugin storage. ## Develop ```sh bun install bun test bunx tsc --noEmit ``` ## Example ## License [MIT](LICENSE)
